title: The Ouroboros of Benchmarking: Reasoning Evaluation in an Era of Saturation
reasoning: The paper provides a comprehensive overview and meta-analysis of reasoning benchmarks for LLMs, focusing on technical domains such as mathematics, logic, coding, and multimodal reasoning. While it includes safety-related benchmarks in its taxonomy, it does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of the study.
